build: Birzzle Fever iOS 1.0.4 with ASLR-relative request, failure, and NSError domain/code hooks
operator_observation: After a few seconds of loading animation, the dialog read: Failed to connect to network. Please check network status.

game_process_observations.relative_log_order: The same game process logged NSURLErrorDomain:-1003 immediately before Failed:1.

interpretation: For this launch, RankingCore connection:didFailWithError: received NSURLErrorDomain code -1003, the Foundation cannot-find-host error: the request hostname could not be resolved. The previous launch logged numeric code 8 without its domain; its cause cannot be inferred or equated with this launch. The request URL, symbolic command and required server-derived state are still unknown; a DNS failure does not specify an offline response format.
next_action: Identify which host request ID 1 contacts and map the server reply consumed at startup before implementing a local offline source. Avoid full-URL or user-data logging; a further manual iPad test requires a new explicit readiness gate.
privacy: No token, member identifier, UDID, account data, full URL or raw crash filename is included. Raw syslog and app archives stay private in ignored ios/captures. Android was not used.
